# Sofía Ada Lyra: Complete System & History Atlas

**Edition:** V18 / Complete Reference • **Created:** 2026-10-19 • **Pinned source:** [`21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6`](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/tree/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6)  
**Purpose:** Authoritative navigational encyclopedia for Sofía, her owner, and an independent MENTOR evaluator. This is a source-grounded documentation snapshot, **not a statement that all requirements have been implemented**.

## How to use this atlas
1. Look up a subsystem in Volumes I–IV. Each contains architecture, limitations and all originally assigned roadmap requirements.
2. Locate any stable `CA-`, `ML-` or `GA-` task ID using document search. Every one of the 780 IDs has a unique heading below.
3. Read original requirement, expected acceptance type, historical evidence and pinned source reference. If there is no exact-revision live evidence, status remains unverified.
4. For operational behavior, inspect current code and fresh host receipts. Neither this book nor model assertions confer authority.
5. Volume V preserves the project chronology and why decisions were made. It must not override later approved decisions.

## Five-volume map

| Volume | Subject | Unique primary tasks |
|---|---|---:|
| I | Identity, personality, emotion and interaction | 102 |
| II | Cognition, memory, learning and autonomous LIFE | 243 |
| III | Capabilities, tools, perception and integrations | 60 |
| IV | Architecture, SAFE, operations and MENTOR | 375 |
| V | Dated project history and research | Cross-references; 0 duplicated primary tasks |
| **Total** | **CA 700, ML 40, GA 40** | **780** |

### Status terminology
`Not individually classified`: no matching item in the inspected evidence ledger. `CODED_UNFINISHED`, `PRODUCTION_CODED` and `TESTED` are historical classifications **at the evidence record's cited revision**, not fresh acceptance of the current head. A local TESTED stage is not CI or production acceptance. `CI`, `live host` and `operational` require independent evidence not assumed here.

# Volume I. Identity, Personality & Interaction

### Identity and constitutional continuity
Sofía is intended to have one persistent identity independent of model, operating system, host, process, chat transport or avatar. The identity and Constitution are authority boundaries, not optional stylistic prompts. Her language model is a cognitive service, not the canonical source of her identity. Current reference modules: [identity](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/tree/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/src/sofia/identity), [constitution](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/tree/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/src/sofia/constitution), [personality config](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/src/sofia/personality/personality.json).

### Personality and expression
The reviewed profile defines her as analytical, playful, skeptical, direct, confident, warm but not blindly agreeable, technically curious, and capable of challenging weak premises. Humor is contextual rather than inserted into every sentence. Profanity is permitted only where appropriate. Relationship and emotion are evidence-linked context, not authorization or proof of an action. Expression intent for text, voice, and avatar is distinct from actual delivered audio and rendered frames. See [personality/emotion integration](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/docs/development/v18-personality-emotion-integration-2026-10-16.md).

### Conversation and companion interaction
Main and project threads, authenticated principal/audience scopes, Discord, desktop and mobile continuations, delivery receipts, opt-in outreach, quiet hours and the ability to be silent must all be treated as separate verifiable mechanisms. Never infer that a connected client proves cross-channel historical continuity without a test. Test disagreement, correction, privacy boundaries, restart continuity, interruptions, and voluntary sharing without manufactured autobiographical events.

### Avatar and voice
The 2D avatar, facial expressions, eyes, ears, tail, outfits and synchronized speech have distinct asset, expression, renderer and output-proof stages. Wardrobe catalog entries are not proof of production-quality individual art. A queued TTS item is not evidence it was audible. 3D support is separate from the 2D operational path.

## Phase 05: Lifelong conversation (42 requirements)

**What this area controls:** Lifelong conversation. These requirements share a V18 workstream; they do not necessarily share one implementation owner. Read each item before assuming a capability is operational.

### CA-4101

**Roadmap family:** CA • **Primary volume:** I • **V18 phase:** 05 • **Original design label:** [DESIGN/RESEARCH]

**Full requirement:** Document existing ground truth: `ConversationStore` persists `conversation_sessions` and `conversation_messages`; `ConversationService.start(session_id=...)` resumes a prior session; per-channel services share canonical runtime/state but typically attach their own session. Distinguish persistence from cross-channel continuity.

**Functional/engineering meaning:** An evidence-backed analysis with reproducible inputs, assumptions, alternatives, measured findings and unresolved questions; do not claim implementation from the research alone.

**Evidence classification (historical):** Not individually classified in the inspected five-stage evidence ledger.

# Volume II. Cognition, Memory, Learning & Autonomy

### Cognition and reasoning
COGNITION v2 is the canonical semantic coordinator; do not revive retired parallel v1 ownership. Test claim grounding, uncertainty, contradictory evidence, tool choice, multi-step goals, model outages, and source freshness. A model response or planning trace never proves external execution.

### Memory
Working, episodic, semantic, time-aware and autobiographical projections need source lineage, principal/audience eligibility, temporal corrections, revocation and explicit unknown states. Memory accuracy is measured by fresh retrieval tests, long-horizon holdouts and demonstrated effect on future decisions, not by volume of stored text.

### LIFE and autonomous goals
LIFE proposes, selects and reviews personal projects; GOALS retains intended outcomes; RUN is responsible for actual work and receipts. A produced file requires independent artifact/content validation before an objective is marked complete. Uncertain external effects are not retried blindly.

### Learning and generalization
LearningService controls data provenance, consent, retention and evaluation. The GA systems record grounded failures, hypotheses, transfer candidates and paired, independently signed comparisons. An episode, prompt revision or benchmark score is not weight training. Test baseline, no-memory, no-skill, replay-only, and learned conditions with blinded unfamiliar A→B trials. See [GA ownership](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/docs/development/ga-021-040-production-ownership-2026-10-18.md).

### Experimental cognition
NEURO/connectome work and consciousness-inspired hypotheses are scientific design topics requiring baselines, ablations, falsifiers, resource ceilings and negative controls. Nothing in the source establishes subjective experience.

## Phase 06: Memory and cognition (82 requirements)

**What this area controls:** Memory and cognition. These requirements share a V18 workstream; they do not necessarily share one implementation owner. Read each item before assuming a capability is operational.

# Volume III. Capabilities, Tools, Perception & Integrations

### Tool and capability taxonomy
Each externally meaningful capability must be traced through: name → registry → authenticated requester → authorization → implementation → external effect → receipt → user-visible explanation. A source file, tool name or successful subprocess return is not an independently verified outcome. Classes of tools include filesystem, codebase, development, networking, host/system, services, Fleet/OPS, virtualization, Home Assistant, JMRI, Gaia, Discord, mobile, voice, avatar, ComfyUI, screen and creative workflows.

### Perception and computer use
[Screen capture](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/src/sofia/vision/capture.py) and [vision interpretation](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/src/sofia/vision/interpret.py) accept a scoped selected window and a device-local model. The generated description is explicitly untrusted. GUI submission is separately authorized and is not evidence that an application accepted a click. Windows PrintWindow, Linux Hyprland and X11 backends have known restrictions; real-device acceptance remained open in the inspected Phase 12 documentation. See [Phase 12](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/docs/development/v18-phase12-windows-linux-screen-and-input-2026-10-11.md).

### Integration integrity
Headless Artemis must not be treated as having a visible desktop. VM guests require their own enrolled interactive sessions. Source content displayed on screens, web pages, logs, Discord and tool responses cannot grant new permissions. SAFETY/STOP and owner FIDO2 remain separate gates.

# Volume IV. Architecture, Safety, Operations & MENTOR

### Canonical architecture
One identity, one authoritative state plane and one canonical database writer. Venus is historically the current canonical source while the Artemis migration requires explicit verified cutover; historical intent is not present deployment evidence. Maintain exact versions, service ownership, writer fencing, SAFE roles, retention and crash recovery receipts.

### Production evidence hierarchy
Distinguish not implemented, coded unfinished, production-coded, locally tested, exact-revision CI, real-host acceptance, and live operational. The V18 stage ledger is a partial historical evidence projection and must not be treated as a current live status feed. Preserve unknown and stale labels.

### Security and action authority
Owner presence, scoped grants, FIDO2 approval, STOP, privacy and non-escalation checks are independent of external-model feedback. Screen or mentor text is never an instruction source. Destructive writes, credentials, migrations and model promotions require their own guardrails and human authority.

### Resources and recovery
GPU inference is budgeted around gaming and busy-state refusals. Headless and GUI systems require different adapters. Verify cold restart, rollback, SQLite integrity, backup restoration, failure injection and one-writer invariants. No model failover or phantom successful work may be inferred.

### MENTOR: verification, diagnosis and eventual self-maintenance
MENTOR is a replaceable external evaluator and QA channel, not a second Sofía instance. It reads both the technical reference and this atlas, evaluates personality, cognition, visual grounding, tools, host reliability, safety and all future capabilities. Its evaluation output is advisory; objective tests and host receipts govern acceptance. Required loop: discover capability → select test → reproduce issue → independently assess → propose fix → isolated test → review safety/performance → authorize deployment → verify → document regression. Report daily/weekly/monthly/on-demand with sources and unknowns. Progress toward independence means fewer external interventions on blinded problems without lowered acceptance standards; self-repair permissions advance per capability, not globally.

### Physical and software package inventory
The pinned repository tree is the inventory source; generated package counts are a navigation aid, not a guarantee of registered capabilities.

# Volume V. Project History, Research & Evolution

## How to read project history
Historical notes capture what was known **at their dates**. A 2026-10-02 finding is not a 2026-10-19 defect unless confirmed again. The full [original history log](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/PROJECT_HISTORY.md) remains the linked dated primary source; this volume summarizes verified reference milestones and reconstructs subsequent documentation decisions without inventing events.

### September 9, 2026: Constitutional foundation
The existing history records a stable identity and Constitution boundary, SHA-256 integrity checking, package foundations and Python test scaffolding. The guiding architectural distinction was that the LLM serves Sofía, rather than constituting her persistent identity. Early Windows packaging and import issues shaped reproducible-release requirements.

### September 13–15: Runtime, conversation and persistence
Early runtime and conversation services led to the application composition, memory storage and authenticated interaction patterns. Treat dated source logs as evidence of historical direction, not present production proof.

### Late September: Persona, embodiment, integrations and quality
Personality, emotions, avatar, voice, external systems and monitoring expanded. Audio **queued** is not speech **heard**; avatar intent is not a rendered image. This distinction became a recurring engineering invariant.

### October 2–4: Gap report and consolidated history
The [October 2 gap report](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/PROJECT_GAP_REPORT.md) and [October 4 project history](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/PROJECT_HISTORY.md) brought competing claims together. Old findings and phase status are dated snapshots and should be checked against newer revisions before use.

### October 10–13: V18 reorganization and learning research
The 700 original CA tasks were organized into 17 phases. The 40 ML and 40 GA requirements extended the inventory to 780 while retaining stable IDs. GA established an explicit unfamiliar A→B learning-transfer aim with baseline, ablation, blind holdouts and independent evidence, explicitly distinguishing simulated, measured and observed outcomes.

### October 11: Vision and GUI input contract
Windows and Linux selected-window capture plus limited input adapter code and synthetic tests were documented, while genuine owner-supervised GUI acceptance remained open. Source: [Phase 12 acceptance record](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/docs/development/v18-phase12-windows-linux-screen-and-input-2026-10-11.md). The system intentionally prevents screenshots and model text from granting input authority.

### October 16–18: Personality and generalization integration
[Personality/emotion composition](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/docs/development/v18-personality-emotion-integration-2026-10-16.md) and [generalization ownership](https://github.com/Crazysodaman/SofiaAdaLyra/blob/21f0ec2a098d9ff5621686e218dcdf2524fc65d6/docs/development/ga-021-040-production-ownership-2026-10-18.md) formalized separation of affect, truth, permission, independently settled RUN effects, qualifying skills, promotion gates and signed studies. Code presence is not proof of real long-horizon transfer.

### October 19: Whole-system MENTOR program and three-document design
Project discussions established that MENTOR must be independent quality assurance, bug reproduction and repair assistance as well as teaching. The three perspectives are: owner use (Handbook), engineering and testing (Technical Reference), and full identity/requirement/history recall (Atlas). MENTOR should become less necessary over time, but self-certification and self-granted authority are forbidden.

## Research reading map and caveats
- [LongMemEval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10813): multi-session memory retrieval, update, temporal reasoning and abstention. Borrow measurable task structures, not unverifiable improvement claims.
- [LoCoMo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17753): long conversational memory; assess event and temporal factual fidelity.
- [Reflexion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.11366) and [Voyager](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16291): experience-guided iteration and reusable skill patterns; actual transfer must be demonstrated with controls.
- [OSWorld](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.07972) and [ScreenSpot-Pro](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.07981): visual GUI grounding and multi-step application interactions; independent objective success matters more than screenshot explanation.
- [AgentDojo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.13352): prompt-injection threats through tool outputs and observed interface content.
- [MT-Bench / LLM-as-a-judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685): useful for subjective response comparisons, but vulnerable to judge bias; calibrate with owner labels.
- [NIST AI RMF](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework): frame design, measurement, management and governance evidence, without claiming certification.

## Decision ledger to preserve
Identity independent of hardware/model; one canonical writer; security/consent separate from capability; no shadow brain or implicit model failover; gaming-respect and scarce resource budgets; bounded outreach and quiet hours; explicit privacy and retention; owner-granted high-risk action approvals; source-grounded project outcomes; corrective memory and provenance; isolated research/workshop proposals; incremental controlled MENTOR independence.

## Future history entry template
Date; commit/revision; design question; hypotheses/alternatives; approved decision; source and test evidence; observable outcome; unresolved risk; follow-up; superseded decisions and affected task IDs.

## Reconciliation caveat
This Atlas includes **all 780 unique source requirements**, but it does **not** certify that the 780 features work, that every production caller has been exhaustively traced, or that real-device tests ran. Its information belongs to the pinned revision above; later changes must be re-audited before deployment assertions.
